properties.label: 邺北城
properties.sourceTitle: 邺城考古图件、分期与定位说明
properties.status: 南北双参照配准的考古图转绘 · 非实测墙界
properties.enStatus: Archaeological plan registered to north/south controls; not surveyed boundaries
properties.note: 何利群2025年图一的邺北城范围，保留图示西南折转及与南城的共用墙界。曹魏、后赵、冉魏、前燕沿用；与现代三台展示区区别。 总图按邺北城西北墙角和朱明门主门道发掘区作南北双参照等比配准，保留原图城墙曲线、共用墙段和门址方位；地下墙体及未发掘城门不是卫星可见实测边界。
properties.enNote: Published overall archaeological plan registered by a similarity transform between the northwest northern-city wall corner and the excavated main passage of Zhuming Gate. Buried walls and other gates remain plan references, not satellite-observed boundaries.

properties.label: 宫城第一圈宫墙
properties.sourceTitle: 邺城考古图件、分期与定位说明
properties.status: 206号基址定位约束的考古图转绘 · 非实测墙界
properties.enStatus: Archaeological plan registered to Hall 206 and roads; not surveyed GIS
properties.note: 按2025年图十第一圈宫墙实线、推测虚线分别追踪；该闭合面仅用于表达推测围合，不把缺口和虚线当作探明墙体。局部图方位以卫星道路实际对应为准。 本轮以206号大殿近景定位为局部参照，并用五处道路交会约束图十比例和方位；这是考古图的地理配准，非逐边卫星描绘。勘探框与推测墙线仍保留原图性质，不能以现代展示铺装替代殿基。
properties.enNote: Figure 10 registered locally to the identifiable Hall 206 ensemble, with five distributed road junctions constraining a similarity transform. Prospecting boxes, partial excavation and inferred walls retain their original meaning. Modern landscaped surfaces are not substituted for ancient foundations.
